sentences.text:

 Mr. A. Tripathy, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha .... Opposite Party
 Mr. A. Pradhan, Asc
 Mr. R. Roy, Adv (Infomant)
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
 Order
17.11.2023 Order No.
03. 1.
Learned counsel Mr. R. Roy and associates on behalf of the informant have filed Vakalatnama along with documents by way of memo.
The same is taken on record.

Name of learned counsel Mr.
R. Roy and associates be reflected in the file, in the cause list as well as in the web portal of this Court.

2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner, learned counsel for the informant and learned counsel for the State.
3. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with T.R. Case No.70 of 2022 pending on the file of learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge under POCSO Act, Nayagarh, arising out of Daspalla P.S. Case No.38 of 2022 for commission of offence alleged under Sections 363/365/366/376(2)(n)/376(3) of IPC read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act and Section 9 of the PCM Act.
4.

Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Additional S.J.-cum-Spl. Judge under POCSO Act, Nayagarh by order dated 08.09.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

5. Perused the order of rejection, which clearly states that the present Petitioner did not appear on the date fixed for which, the trial is lingering and Petitioner has been taken into custody pursuant to Siba @ Bhoi Sethi vs State Of Odisha ....

entities.text: Siba @ Bhoi Sethi vs State Of Odisha

sentences.text:
Opposite Party on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48162098/
1 issuance of NBW(A).
6. It is apt to point out, as rightly noted by the learned Court in seisin that one of the bailors was the father of the accused.
7. Taking into account the conduct of the Petitioner, this Court is not inclined to entertain this bail application at this stage.
8. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
9. Learned Court in seisin is requested to expedite the trial.
